contract_attacks.attack: real signatures moved to a fresh deposit id (one field changed)
a fresh deposit id plus the amount doubled
a fresh deposit id plus another receiver
a fresh deposit id, credited directly instead of into Intents

service_attacks.attack: claim queued on the route Worker that redirects a real, already routed deposit to another receiver, with a key that did not make the deposit
service_attacks.refused_with: address(publicKey) is not the sender of the deposit

service_attacks.attack: a second service process on the same state directory
service_attacks.refused_with: state-curve is in use by process <pid>

how_to_rerun: node scripts/ops/attack-route.mjs (needs the relayer seed; any NEAR account can send the same inputs)
note: Live attacks change the deposit id (to reach the signature check instead of the replay check) and at most one other field; single-field isolation on an unused attestation is in tests/bridge.sandbox.mjs.
